title: Software for Alternative Communication
brief_summary: The aim of this study is evaluate a software developed for alternative communication designed for people with speech difficulties. The software was executed by 30 volunteers using mobile devices that helped to play the scenarios simulated of communication situations.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cerebral Palsy and speech disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* visual impairment and / or severe cognitive impairment
